summary: This is an 8-K filed by Wells Fargo Commercial Mortgage Securities, Inc. as depositor for a commercial mortgage-backed securities (CMBS) trust. The filing reports the execution of an underwriting agreement on May 8, 2026, for the sale of $512,996,000 in Commercial Mortgage Pass-Through Certificates, Series 2026-5C9, expected to close May 28, 2026. This is a routine CMBS issuance and securitization transaction, not a special-situation event. The filing discloses the underwriters, master servicer, special servicer, and other transaction parties. There are no terms relevant to acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, tender offers, going-private, or any other special situation category.
